title: Flower-Shaped Hwajeon Dessert
description: A traditional Korean dessert, hwajeon, reimagined with a Mexican twist to create a sweet and delicate flower-shaped treat.
instructions: 2. Prepare the hwajeon batter according to package instructions or recipe.
3. Using a cookie cutter, cut out flower shapes from the batter.
4. Place the flower shapes on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
5. Bake for 15-20 minutes or until the edges are golden brown.
6. In a small bowl, mix together the melted chocolate and honey.
7. Remove the hwajeon flowers from the oven and let them cool for 5 minutes.
8. Dip the top of each flower into the chocolate-honey mixture.
9. Sprinkle with chili flakes, if desired.
